raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Two FlashInfer MegaMoE changes found while adding Beam (#44747), split out of #45256 at review because neither is specific to Beam.

1. **Startup autotune fails on FlashInfer 0.7.2.**
   - The tuning sweep warms each capacity profile with `knobs="auto"` but passes no output buffer.
   - On backends that support output views, warmup then runs `compute(output=None)`. The NVFP4 CuTe DSL backend rejects that with `ValueError: compute(output=None) is incompatible with knobs='auto'`.
   - So a MegaMoE NVFP4 server with default autotune and a cold tuning cache fails at startup, on every rank.
2. **Small decode batches use the full-capacity workspace.** MegaMoE's per-call cost scales with workspace capacity, and without startup autotuning every forward uses the main profile.

## Modifications

- **Autotune.** `MegaMoeTunedForward` allocates a BF16 output buffer for the sweep and passes it to `warmup`.
- **Optional decode workspace** (`SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MEGAMOE_DECODE_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK`):
  - `0`, the default, is off. Otherwise the value must satisfy `0 < capacity < main capacity`; any other value fails when the first MegaMoE layer is built.
  - It is a second workspace profile on the same MegaMoE layer, built only for ModelOpt NVFP4 MoE.
  - A forward uses it only when no DP rank extends and every rank's DP-gathered token count fits. All ranks read the same gathered counts, so they choose the same profile.
  - It is unused (logged once) while startup autotuning runs, since the tuned profiles already size small batches. It takes effect with `--disable-flashinfer-autotune` or `--flashinfer-autotune-skip-ops flashinfer_megamoe`.
- Documented in `environment_variables.mdx`.

## Accuracy Tests

The runs below are on 4×GB300 with FlashInfer 0.7.2, using `reflection/Beam-1.0-501B-A23B-NVFP4` with MegaMoE TP4/DP4/EP4. They ran on the Beam stack (#45256 and its base), which carried these same changes. GSM8K is sgl-eval, 1,319 questions, temperature 0.

| Configuration | GSM8K | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Before the fix: default autotune, cold tuning cache, with DFlash | — | every rank fails at startup with the `ValueError` above |
| With the fix: default autotune, cold tuning cache | 96.44% | 13 capacities tuned, zero request errors |
| Autotune off, decode workspace off, with DFlash | 96.44% | zero errors |
| Autotune off, decode workspace 256, with DFlash | 96.29% | isolated outputs identical to workspace off; all 4 ranks make the same choice on every forward |
| Autotune off, decode workspace 64, with DFlash | 96.06% | decode profile chosen only up to 64 tokens per rank, main above; CUDA graphs on both sides |

`test_flashinfer_megamoe.py`:
- the autotune sweep now asserts it receives an output buffer;
- a new case covers the decode workspace: skipped under autotune, validated, and chosen only when every rank fits and none extends.

`test_flashinfer_megamoe.py` passes on this branch.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not measured for the decode workspace.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch: @@ -361,6 +361,11 @@ SGLang supports various environment variables that can be used to configure its Per-rank FlashInfer MegaMOE symmetric-workspace token capacity. A value of 0 derives the capacity from the runtime token limits. 0 + + SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MEGAMOE_DECODE_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK + Per-rank token capacity of an extra, smaller FlashInfer MegaMOE workspace for decode-only forwards of ModelOpt NVFP4 MoE layers. Either 0 (off) or 0 < capacity < main capacity, where the main capacity is SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MEGAMOE_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK or its derived value; any other value fails when the first MegaMOE layer is built. A forward uses it only when no DP rank extends and every EP rank's batch fits; otherwise it uses the main workspace. Unused (logged once) while MegaMoE startup autotuning runs, since the tuned capacity profiles already serve small batches; it takes effect with --disable-flashinfer-autotune or --flashinfer-autotune-skip-ops flashinfer_megamoe. + 0 + SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MEGAMOE_IN_KERNEL_FC2_REDUCE Permit CuTe DSL MegaMOE in-kernel FC2 reduction for NVFP4 W4A4, NVFP4 W4A16, and MXFP8. FlashInfer's tuning profile may still select external reduction. BF16 atomic accumulation is nondeterministic; leave disabled for reproducibility. Requires BF16 combine.

@@ -1294,6 +1294,11 @@ class Envs:
     # per-rank symmetric workspace; must be >= the largest padded per-rank batch
     # (derived from cuda_graph_max_bs / chunked_prefill_size when unset).
     SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MEGAMOE_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK = EnvInt(0)
+    # Opt-in smaller MegaMOE workspace (per-call cost scales with capacity) for
+    # decode-only forwards of ModelOpt NVFP4 MoE; 0 is off. Unused when startup
+    # autotuning runs, whose profiles already size small batches. A forward that
+    # exceeds it on any EP rank, or extends on any DP rank, uses the main one.
+    SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MEGAMOE_DECODE_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK = EnvInt(0)
     # Opt-in in-kernel FC2 top-k reduce (cross-rank REDG atomic-add) for the
     # cutedsl mega kernels (NVFP4 W4A4 / W4A16 and MXFP8). Permits in-kernel
     # reduction; FlashInfer's tuning profile may still select external reduction.

@@ -22,6 +22,7 @@
 
 from __future__ import annotations
 
+import functools
 import logging
 from collections.abc import Callable, Generator
 from contextlib import contextmanager
@@ -119,6 +120,8 @@ def _pack_ue8m0_to_int(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 class FlashInferMegaMoeQuantInfo(MoeQuantInfo):
     mega: Any
     mega_forward: Callable[[Any, Any], torch.Tensor] | None = None
+    # A smaller capacity profile of ``mega`` for decode-only forwards.
+    mega_decode_workspace: Any = None
     fc1_alpha: torch.Tensor | None = None
     fc2_alpha: torch.Tensor | None = None
     fc1_norm_const: torch.Tensor | None = None
@@ -160,6 +163,67 @@ def _resolve_max_tokens_per_rank() -> int:
     return derived if derived > 0 else 1024
 
 
+def _resolve_decode_max_tokens_per_rank(max_tokens_per_rank: int) -> int:
+    """Capacity of the optional decode-only workspace; 0 means none."""
+    configured = envs.SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MEGAMOE_DECODE_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK.get()
+    if configured == 0:
+        return 0
+    if not 0 < configured < max_tokens_per_rank:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MEGAMOE_DECODE_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK="
+            f"{configured} must be 0 (off) or below the main MegaMoE capacity "
+            f"of {max_tokens_per_rank} tokens per rank."
+        )
+    return configured
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def _log_decode_workspace_skipped() -> None:
+    logger.info(
+        "SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MEGAMOE_DECODE_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK is unused: "
+        "MegaMoE startup autotuning already prepares small-capacity profiles."
+    )
+
+
+def _maybe_create_decode_workspace(mega: Any, max_tokens_per_rank: int) -> Any:
+    capacity = _resolve_decode_max_tokens_per_rank(max_tokens_per_rank)
+    if capacity == 0:
+        return None
+    from sglang.srt.layers.moe.flashinfer_megamoe_autotune import (
+        megamoe_autotune_active,
+    )
+
+    # The tuned forward's profiles size small batches with tuned tactics, and
+    # FlashInfer allows one live workspace per capacity.
+    if megamoe_autotune_active():
+        _log_decode_workspace_skipped()
+        return None
+    return mega.create_workspace(capacity)
+
+
+def _select_decode_workspace(quant_info: FlashInferMegaMoeQuantInfo) -> Any:
+    """The decode workspace if every EP rank's batch fits in it, else None.
+
+    MegaMOE is a lockstep collective, so the choice reads only DP-synchronized
+    state. The token bound also catches prefill-sized forwards that publish
+    extend=False; such forwards keep the main workspace.
+    """
+    workspace = quant_info.mega_decode_workspace
+    if workspace is None:
+        return None
+
+    from sglang.srt.layers.dp_attention import (
+        get_dp_global_num_tokens,
+        get_is_extend_in_batch,
+    )
+
+    if get_is_extend_in_batch():
+        return None
+    if max(get_dp_global_num_tokens()) > workspace.max_tokens_per_rank:
+        return None
+    return workspace
+
+
 def resolve_flashinfer_megamoe_combine_dtype() -> str:
     combine_dtype = envs.SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MEGAMOE_COMBINE_DTYPE.get().strip().lower()
     if combine_dtype not in ("bf16", "mxfp8", "nvfp4"):
@@ -239,6 +303,7 @@ def _bind_transformed_weights(
 
 def _init_flashinfer_megamoe_layer_state(layer: FusedMoE) -> None:
     layer._flashinfer_megamoe_layer = None
+    layer._flashinfer_megamoe_decode_workspace = None
     layer._flashinfer_megamoe_forward = None
     layer._flashinfer_megamoe_input_norm_const = None
 
@@ -255,6 +320,7 @@ def _ensure_flashinfer_megamoe_layer(
     megakernel_config: Any,
     w13_scale: torch.Tensor,
     w2_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    with_decode_workspace: bool = False,
 ) -> Any:
     mega = _get_or_init_flashinfer_megamoe_layer_state(layer)
     if mega is not None:
@@ -325,6 +391,10 @@ def _ensure_flashinfer_megamoe_layer(
         )
     else:
         layer._flashinfer_megamoe_forward = _select_megamoe_forward(mega)
+    if with_decode_workspace:
+        layer._flashinfer_megamoe_decode_workspace = _maybe_create_decode_workspace(
+            mega, max_tokens_per_rank
+        )
     return mega
 
 
@@ -412,6 +482,8 @@ def ensure_nvfp4_moe_layer_for_flashinfer_megamoe(layer: FusedMoE) -> Any:
         megakernel_config=megakernel_config,
         w13_scale=layer.w13_weight_scale,
         w2_scale=layer.w2_weight_scale,
+        # Only ModelOptNvFp4FusedMoEMethod passes the decode workspace on.
+        with_decode_workspace=True,
     )
 
 
@@ -668,6 +740,7 @@ def run_flashinfer_megamoe(
     topk_weights = topk_output.topk_weights
     topk_ids = topk_output.topk_ids
     mega = quant_info.mega
+    decode_workspace = _select_decode_workspace(quant_info)
 
     t = MoEEpTensors(
         hidden_states=x.to(torch.bfloat16),
@@ -683,7 +756,14 @@ def run_flashinfer_megamoe(
     )
     with _capture_safe_ue8m0_pack():
         assert quant_info.mega_forward is not None
-        y = quant_info.mega_forward(mega, t)
+        if decode_workspace is None:
+            y = quant_info.mega_forward(mega, t)
+        else:
+            y = mega.forward(
+                t,
+                workspace=decode_workspace,
+                return_workspace_view=mega.supports_output_view,
+            )
 
     if quant_info.apply_routed_scaling_factor:
         rsf = runner_config.routed_scaling_factor

@@ -76,6 +76,11 @@ def megamoe_autotune_context(
                 tuner.publish_namespaced_records(_CACHE_NAMESPACE, context.records)
 
 
+def megamoe_autotune_active() -> bool:
+    """Whether startup tuning is preparing MegaMoE capacity profiles now."""
+    return _active_context is not None
+
+
 @contextmanager
 def _native_cache(path: Path):
     # Native AUTO exposes its winner through this file; generic autotune owns
@@ -245,7 +250,14 @@ def _tune(self, tensors, capacity: int, native_path: Path):
         )
         payload = None
         try:
-            temporary.warmup(tensors)
+            # The knobs="auto" sweep needs a caller-owned output buffer; without
+            # one, output-view backends run compute(output=None) and reject it.
+            output = torch.empty(
+                (tensors.num_tokens, self.fleet_params.token_hidden_size),
+                dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+                device=tensors.hidden_states.device,
+            )
+            temporary.warmup(replace(tensors, output=output))
             if self.bootstrap.rank == 0:
                 try:
                     payload = json.loads(native_path.read_text())

@@ -3221,6 +3221,7 @@ def apply(
             quant_info = FlashInferMegaMoeQuantInfo(
                 mega=mega,
                 mega_forward=layer._flashinfer_megamoe_forward,
+                mega_decode_workspace=layer._flashinfer_megamoe_decode_workspace,
                 fc1_alpha=layer.g1_alphas,
                 fc2_alpha=layer.g2_alphas,
                 fc1_norm_const=None if use_w4a16 else layer.w2_input_scale_quant,

@@ -48,6 +48,9 @@ def register_fused_func(*_args, **_kwargs):
         SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MEGAMOE_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK=types.SimpleNamespace(
             get=lambda: 0
         ),
+        SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MEGAMOE_DECODE_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK=types.SimpleNamespace(
+            get=lambda: 0
+        ),
         SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MEGAMOE_COMBINE_DTYPE=types.SimpleNamespace(
             get=lambda: "bf16"
         ),
@@ -121,6 +124,7 @@ class Tensors:
         topk_weights: torch.Tensor
         fc1_alpha: torch.Tensor
         scales: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        output: torch.Tensor | None = None
 
         @property
         def num_tokens(self):
@@ -249,6 +253,8 @@ def __init__(self, **kwargs):
 
         def warmup(self, inputs, workspace=None):
             if self.auto:
+                # FlashInfer's output-view backends reject a sweep without one.
+                assert inputs.output.shape == inputs.hidden_states.shape
                 events.append("tune")
                 Path(os.environ["FLASHINFER_MOE_EP_KNOB_CACHE"]).write_text(
                     json.dumps(payload)
